name: Destiny Dissonance
body:
Discipline clairsentience; Level seer 1, sighted seeker 1

MANIFESTING

Display Material and mental
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Touch
Target Creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw None; Power Resistance Yes
Power Points 1

DESCRIPTION

Your mere touch grants your foe an imperfect, unfocused glimpse of the many possible futures in store. Unaccustomed to and unable to process the information, the subject becomes sickened for 1 round per level of the manifester if you succeed on a melee touch attack.
